senses.gloss:
इतर इ-तर (from the pronominal base इ, see इदम्), adj., f. रा, n. रद् (ved. रम्, cf. Lat. iterum),
 1. Other, Man. 1, 70; इतर-इतरैर् अथ वा इतरैः, By these or those, MBh. 2, 2503.
 2. Contrary, e. g. विजयाय इतराय वा, To victory or defeat, MBh. 1, 4092.
 --Comp.
 --When the latter part of a comp. word it signifies,
 I. negation of the former part, e. g. द्विज-, m. one who is not a Brāhmaṇa, Ragh. 9, 76.
इतर-इतर इतर-इतर, adj., used generally only in the oblique cases of the sing., 1. mutual, with each another, Pañc. ii. d. 136. 2. several Man. 3, 35.
इतरतस् इतर + तस्, adv., Repeated; इतरतश् चेतरतः, Hither and thither, Rām. 2, 105, 13.
इतरथा इतर + था, adv. Else, Śiś. 9, 13.
इतरेतरतस् इतरेतरतस्, i. e. इतर-इतर + तस्, adv. One from the other. MBh. 1, 7403.

इतस् इ + तस् (from the pronominal base इ, see इदम्),
 I. = the abl. of इदम्, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 2 (from this person, i. e. from myself); Hiḍ. 1, 5, [] than this, i. e. than
 I.
 II. adv.
 1. From hence, from this place, Rām. 3, 54, 28; from this time, MBh. 3, 204; therefore, Rām. 5, 81, 45.
 2. Hither, Rām. 5, 13, 9; Ragh. 2, 34, against myself.
 3. इतस्-इतस्, Here--there, Śāk. 29, 20; इतश्चेतश् च, Here and there, Pañc. 20, 25.
इतरेतरकाम्या इतरेतरकाम्या, i. e. इतर-इतर-, f.; instr. sing. according to their several fancies, Man. 3, 35.
